fails.headline: Kyiv-area depot blast death toll rises to 37 as Ukraine opens criminal case for negligence
fails.reason: headline: states the toll is 37, but cited source A367 (Straits Times) reports 'Kyiv region strike death toll rises to 38, Volodymyr Zelensky says' -- a direct contradiction from within this story's own sources; summary: repeats the same unsupported/outdated '37' figure ('killing at least 37 people') despite the cited A367 update to 38.

fails.headline: Venezuela's Rodriguez defends US oil deal as critics at home call it colonialism

fails.headline: US military chiefs warn Hegseth against extending Iran operations as six-month costs mount

fails.headline: Kim Jong Un removes defence minister in military reshuffle as Trump raises North Korea talks

fails.headline: Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan hold first meeting under new mutual-defence pact

fails.headline: Venezuela defends 25-year US oil deal as retaining sovereignty; critics call it a takeover

fails.headline: Iran war at six months: 18 US troops killed, Trump's approval at record low
